title: Binance Futures Will Postpone the Launch of PLANCKUSDT Perpetual Contract
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, The trading start time for the  PLANCKUSDT Perpetual Contract , originally set at 2025-11-14 08:00 (UTC), will be postponed until further notice.  For More Information : Planck (PLANCK) Will Be Available on Binance Alpha and Binance Futures (2025-11-13) Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-11-14
